name: Käte wall
description:
Four interlocking bricks form a small wall with Käte recessed across the front, including both umlaut dots. Uses two 2 x 4 bricks and two 2 x 2 bricks in staggered rows: bottom 2 x 4 then 2 x 2; top 2 x 2 then 2 x 4, viewed from the front. Six studs wide, two bricks high, two studs deep; body 47.8 x 15.8 x 19.2 mm, or 21 mm tall including top studs. Text recess 0.6 mm deep; plain backs with no placement labels.
Print kate-wall.stl once for all four bricks, at 100% scale with studs up and open undersides on the bed. Supports off, internal brims off, 0.12-0.16 mm layers. combined.stl is a preview only. Individual bricks are also available.
This is a smaller lettering test for the Meissner wall. The base brick has been physically tested; this engraving has not.
